repair: Repeat each identical frozen URL exactly once using curl --http1.1, with no redirects/retries, same timeout/headers, into an attempt-specific repair1 directory. Preserve original empty-body/header bytes and NAS receipt. This changes transport only, not series, observation dates, source/feature formula, five-session lag, freshness or acceptance gate.
stop: Any non-200, empty/malformed CSV, identity mismatch, failed NAS backup/restore or Qlib calendar mismatch stops with exact receipt; no third transport, host, endpoint or date fallback. Original request counts remain consumed.
